description: This file implements traffic class handling for network packets in Zephyr OS, including thread creation, queue submission, and priority mapping for transmit and receive traffic classes.

methods.name: submit_to_queue
methods.description: Helper function to enqueue packets into a FIFO queue.

methods.name: net_tc_submit_to_tx_queue
methods.description: Submits a packet to the transmit traffic class queue, setting transmission timestamp.

methods.name: net_tc_submit_to_rx_queue
methods.description: Submits a packet to the receive traffic class queue, setting reception timestamp.

methods.name: net_tx_priority2tc
methods.description: Converts network priority to traffic class for transmission.

methods.name: net_rx_priority2tc
methods.description: Converts network priority to traffic class for reception.

methods.name: net_tc_tx_init
methods.description: Initializes transmit traffic class handler threads and queues.

methods.name: net_tc_rx_init
methods.description: Initializes receive traffic class handler threads and queues.
